node.title: generator size budget check
node.statement: The signed-8-core raw subset count exceeds 2^89 only by multiplying each core by binom(56,28) zero-sum antipodal paddings with identical e1. Its distinct-center upper bound is 19 binom(64,8)<2^37, and even all 2^8 sign patterns give fewer than 2^41 centers. Therefore this family does not meet the generator_economy budget.
node.notes: The raw count 19*C(64,8)*C(56,28) is correct; its padding factor is collision multiplicity, not value-set mass.
